svg.title: Prosthetist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as prosthetist, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: An artificial leg has a shaped socket, round articulation, narrow pylon and a separate formed foot. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, an oval face.
